override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Phantom loop as read: (a) shots on a non-CC target apply Calling Card (DEF -32.19%, 5s) + one Thief's Dagger stack (Hit Rate +25.75%, max 3); (b) shots during CC grant Attack Damage +75.17% for 1 round (durationShots:1); (c) at 3 daggers, skill2 fires an 84.33% additional-damage rider at the CC target + a stacking 12.86% Distributed Damage self-buff, then consumes all daggers; (d) every 10 hits: ATK +85.12% (5s) + Distributed Damage +31.92% (10s); (e) burst: 1457.28% Distributed Damage, FB-exempt. Dagger accrual cadence is the dominant unknown (everyN:60 is a derived guess from the 5s CC lockout, not a measurement).

flags.reasoning: Thief's Dagger only accrues on targets NOT in Calling Card; CC lasts 5s and reapplies on expiry, so real accrual ≈ 1 stack per 5s CC lockout. No not-in-status gate exists, so everyN approximates it. Fire rate itself is datamine-unreliable. If the game instead refreshes CC without blocking dagger gain, accrual is per-shot (everyN:1) and skill2 proc frequency rises ~20x.
